questions.question: The per-leaf output scan flags the ERB File.read / YAML.load_file / HTTP_SECRET placeholders you confirmed. Exempt leaf hits whose WHOLE value is one of those placeholder shapes (same strict rule as the literal check: single file-read call on a plain path with only strip/chomp/to_json/flatten/first, or an ALL_CAPS_WITH_UNDERSCORE token the same render substitutes)?

options.label: Yes, same rule (Rec.)
options.description: Gitlab's secret side qualifies; a mixed value (literal + File.read, rescue fallback, comment) still refuses.

options.label: No, keep refusing
options.description: Ship the harden as is; gitlab stays refused on the secret side.

questions.question: ESO trailing comment (`runner-registration-token: "" # need to leave…`) is treated as a comment, not a value. Keep that?

options.label: Keep (Rec.)
options.description: Same as any comment elsewhere; both directions pinned.

options.label: Revert
options.description: Your gitlab HelmRelease then needs the comment moved to its own line.

questions.question: Gitlab is also blocked by the template-hazard gate (lookup/random/time/unbalanced_template_action) and the 20-object budget (46 outputs over). Scope for now?

options.label: Ship secret side, file rows
options.description: Land this harden after a narrow second refute + gate; file the hazard gate and budget as rows for a later wave.

options.description: Read-only scout of the hazard gate and budget in parallel; decide after.
